description_en: Invoke SaveSingleTaskForModifyingDSRecord to submit a job for modifying a DS record.
name: SaveSingleTaskForModifyingDSRecord

parameters.help_en:
Language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese  
en: English  

Default value: en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Key tag used to identify DNSSEC records. It is an integer less than 65536.
parameters.help_zh: 关键标签，用于标识DNSSEC记录，为小于65536的整数值
parameters.name: key_tag

parameters.help_en:
Encryption algorithm number. For more information, see Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) Algorithm Numbers (https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-sec-alg-numbers/dns-sec-alg-numbers.xhtml). Valid values:  
1: RSA/MD5  
2: Diffie-Hellman  
3: DSA/SHA-1  
5: RSA/SHA-1  
6: DSA-NSEC3-SHA1  
7: RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1  
8: RSA/SHA-256  
10: RSA/SHA-512  
12: GOST R 34.10-2001  
13: ECDSA Curve P-256 with SHA-256  
14: ECDSA Curve P-384 with SHA-384  
15: Ed2551916 Ed448  
252: Reserved for Indirect Keys  
253: private algorithm  
254: private algorithm OID
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法编号，详见Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) Algorithm Numbers (https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-sec-alg-numbers/dns-sec-alg-numbers.xhtml)。取值：
1 RSA/MD5；
2 Diffie-Hellman；
3 DSA/SHA-1；
5 RSA/SHA-1；
6：DSA-NSEC3-SHA1；
7：RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1；
8：RSA/SHA-256；
10：RSA/SHA-512；
12：GOST R 34.10-2001；
13：ECDSA Curve P-256 with SHA-256；
14：ECDSA Curve P-384 with SHA-384；
15：Ed2551916 Ed448；
252：Reserved for Indirect Keys；
253：private algorithm；
254：private algorithm OID
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
Digest algorithm type. For more information, see Delegation Signer (DS) Resource Record (RR) Type Digest Algorithms (https://www.iana.org/assignments/ds-rr-types/ds-rr-types.xhtml). Valid values:  
1: SHA-1  
2: SHA-256  
3: GOST R 34.11-94  
4: SHA-384
